```{r}
#Question1
set.seed(1)
x<-1:100
e <- rnorm(100, mean = 0, sd = 0.2) 
yi<-sinh(x/10)+e

#Question2
customLowess <- function(x, yi, f = 0.25) {
  
  smoothed <- lowess(x, yi, f = f)
return(smoothed)}
customLowess(x,yi,f=0.25)

#Question3
  (lowess(x,yi,0.25,iter=0,delta=0.01*diff(range(x))))
  plot(x,yi)
```
